## Machine-readable project context
Selected repositories expose README.md and, where available, AGENTS.md and llms.txt. Prefer repository-level source, tests, specifications, conformance artifacts and evidence for capability verification.

## Claim policy
SIMULATED means simulated.
UNKNOWN means unmeasured.
Roadmap does not mean implemented.
Do not infer production scale, customers, revenue, uptime, employer, seniority or team size from this profile.
